method.algorithm: deterministic RANSAC then linear least-squares, up to 3 roof planes per supplied envelope
method.sourceSelection: first-return, unclassified, 1.8–8 m above nearby ground plane; 1.5 m envelope query buffer
method.publication: Aggregate roof and ground measurements only; raw returns remain in ignored local cache.

facilities.sourceGeometry: 2024 ortho envelope plus 1.5 m query buffer; plane geometry comes from 2025 laser coordinates

planes.interpretation: minor planar subset; may be a connected or neighbouring roof rather than part of the dominant gable

limitations: Roof support hull is an inner envelope of sampled roof returns; it is not a wall outline.
Ground fit uses the surrounding five metre window, not a measured entrance threshold.
Roof eave and ridge ends are undersampled; allow about 0.5–1 m horizontal uncertainty.

roofSupportRectangle.meaning: 1st–99th percentile support projected on fitted ridge; sampled inner roof envelope, not a survey of walls/eaves

ridge.status: intersection of the two largest fitted roof planes; validate roof assembly and endpoint extent with photographs

roofInterpretation.reason: Dominant planar subsets are shallow, do not form a supported convex gable, and contain discontinuities. Do not turn their intersection into a ridge.
roofInterpretation.modelRecommendation: Use photographs to establish roof type; retain measured roof return height envelope approximately 33.2–34.8 m RH2000.

limitations: The source is June 2025 airborne laser at roughly metre horizontal sampling, not a facade survey.
Planar fit residual is internal scatter, not total survey accuracy.
Windows, doors, terrace elevation, materials and present-day changes require photographic or field evidence.
Do not move measured roofs to match relief-displaced aerial image roof outlines.

surroundingConstruction.useAndOwnership: unconfirmed; do not classify as golf maintenance

surroundingConstruction.inference: The height distribution and 2024 construction context strongly support a completed building by the laser capture; facade, roof form and use remain unverified.
